mentions.name: Morel Mushroom Phenology Map
mentions.description: A map application that lets the builder, friends, and family explore data overlays about morel mushroom phenology and habitat in their local area, including ground temperature, moisture, terrain, aspect, and tree species, with lightweight forecasting and timing models to predict near-term fruiting. Planned to expand to other seasonal natural phenomena such as smelt/salmon runs and wildflower blooms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a small map application that allows me/friends/family to explore data overlays about morel mushrooms phenology and habitat (ground temp/moisture/terrain/aspect/tree species/etc) in our area. There’s some lightweight forecasting and timing models to help guess at near-term fruiting.
